title: 第7章 超越时空的见解
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
总体来说，自己的付出还是得到了回报的。精心剽窃的两款划时代的武器得到了自己叔叔的认同，依靠叔叔的资历和影响力，在巴伐利亚军中推广，替换老旧的武器应该没啥问题。仿制的M1897型速射炮和威克斯机枪绝对可以让巴伐利亚陆军在未来十年内保持技术优势。
虽然同样是速射炮，但是依然也是分三六九等的。法国人的M1897可以一分钟打出15到18发7。2KG的炮弹。而德国人的1896型77毫米速射炮的投射能力不过是一分钟8到9发6。85KG的炮弹。而日本人的75MM速射炮每分钟的射速只有6到7发，弹重仅仅5千克！性能差距一目了然！
虽然历史上1战的时候法国的75速射炮被更射程更远威力更大的各种榴弹炮压制，但是那只能归功于技术的进步，毕竟你是拿1897年的武器去对付1910年左右的武器，差了十多年的技术差距那是神也救不了的！这不能说75小姐不优秀，只能归功于历史局限性了。
至于威克斯机枪吗？总体来说，后世一战中几个国家大量装备的水冷式机枪性能差别并不大，之所以选择威克斯有两个愿意，一个原因是轻！另外一个原因是射界比较好，使用了三脚架的威克斯机枪自然要比使用了橇式四脚架的轻一些，射界也更宽阔一些，抢架的重量少了十多公斤，这可是一个非常客观的重量啊。至于说几款机枪的火力，那是真差不多。
“说说你的想法。”仆从送上咖啡和茶点之后就立刻了，屋内只剩下叔侄两人。亲王注视着眼前的侄子，平静的说道。
“速射自动武器的普及将是历史的必然，很多国家都在研究，其中就包括我们的宿敌——法国！机枪和速射炮迟早会改变战争的情况。能领先一步的军队将获得巨大优势。”嘴上这么说，心中却盘算着能赚多少钱的王子殿下说道。
“如果双方都装备了大量的速射火炮和机枪的话，你认为我们是优势还是劣势？”亲王突然说出了一个毫不相干的问题。
“劣势！法国人不傻，他们也会及时更新自己的武器库，而当大量的速射武器装备部队之后，极少的兵力就可以拦截大规模部队的进攻，配合上防御工事的话，防御方的优势将大于进攻方，而作为一个位于欧洲大陆中部的国家，我们必须把胜利的希望寄托于速战速决，否则的话，西面的法国和东面的俄国最终会将帝国拖垮。”毕竟是穿越者，1战德国怎么死的他还是很清楚，西线打不动，最后被群殴至死。即使开始拥有炮兵优势如何？最后不还是被挡在了巴黎之外？
“最关键的是后勤！速射炮和自动武器的弹药消耗量实在是太大了，知道吗？普法战争的时候我们打了6个月，但是每个步兵才平均打出65发子弹！这个数量甚至少于士兵们携带的弹药数量。但是现在，如果没记错的话，一挺机枪一分钟就可以打出450发以上的子弹！全自动化部队的后勤压力太大了，脱离了铁路线我们根本不可能快速机动，而如果没有机动性的话，一旦对方完成动员，我们的速战速决的计划将成为泡影，这绝对是致命的！”亲王说道。
啪嗒一声，鲁普雷希特手中的勺子掉进了杯子中，亲王的话可谓是正中要点，他从后勤角度论证了施里芬计划的必败的原因！而这个时候施里芬还没有当上总参谋长，还没有开始研究他的那个谋划了十几年的计划！这份敏锐和洞察力可谓是惊人，要不人家能当上德国东线总司令啊！这份眼光和本事着实让人惊叹！
如果说施里芬计划的战术精髓是集中兵力到右翼，然后以压倒性的兵力优势在短时间内以闪电战的方式彻底击溃对方的话，那么这个计划的后勤精髓就在于将铁路作为一种进攻的工具，通过抢占对方铁路线，在极短的时间里将部队输送到战斗位置，并且一路奔向巴黎！

content_en:
Overall, my efforts have paid off. The two epoch-making weapons that were carefully plagiarized were approved by his uncle. Relying on his qualifications and influence, he could promote them in the Bavarian army and replace the old weapons with no problem. The imitation M1897 rapid-fire cannon and Vickers machine gun will definitely allow the Bavarian Army to maintain its technological advantage in the next ten years.
Although it is also a rapid-fire cannon, it is still divided into three, six and nine levels. The French M1897 can fire 15 to 18 rounds of 7.2KG shells per minute. The projection capability of the German 1896 77mm rapid-fire gun is only 8 to 9 rounds of 6.85KG shells per minute. The Japanese 75MM rapid-fire gun has a rate of fire of only 6 to 7 rounds per minute, and the bullet weighs only 5 kilograms! The performance gap is clear at a glance!
Although the French 75mm rapid-fire cannon was suppressed by various howitzers with longer range and greater power during World War I, this can only be attributed to technological progress. After all, you are using weapons from 1897 to deal with weapons from around 1910. The technical gap of more than ten years cannot be saved by God! This cannot be said that Miss 75 is not excellent, it can only be attributed to historical limitations.
As for the Vickers machine gun? Generally speaking, there is not much difference in the performance of water-cooled machine guns that were equipped in large quantities by several countries in World War I. There are two reasons why I chose Wicks. One reason is that it is light! Another reason is that the shooting range is better. The Vickers machine gun using a tripod is naturally lighter than the one using a sled quadruod, and the shooting range is wider. The weight of the grab frame is less than ten kilograms, which is a very objective weight. As for the firepower of several machine guns, they are really about the same.
"Tell me what you think." The servant immediately gave him coffee and tea, and only the uncle and nephew were left in the room. The prince looked at his nephew in front of him and said calmly.
"The popularization of rapid-fire automatic weapons will be a historical necessity. Many countries are studying it, including our old enemy - France! Machine guns and rapid-fire cannons will change the situation of war sooner or later. The army that can stay one step ahead will gain a huge advantage." He said this, but in his heart he was thinking about how much money he could make.
"If both sides are equipped with a large number of rapid-fire artillery and machine guns, do you think we have an advantage or a disadvantage?" The prince suddenly asked an irrelevant question.
"Disadvantage! The French are not stupid. They will also update their weapons arsenal in time. When a large number of rapid-fire weapons are equipped with troops, a very small number of troops can intercept the attack of large-scale troops. If combined with fortifications, the defender's advantage will be greater than that of the attacker. As a country located in In the countries in the middle of the European continent, we must pin our hopes for victory on a quick victory, otherwise, France in the west and Russia in the east will eventually bring down the empire." After all, he is a time traveler. He still knows how Germany died in the first battle. The western front could not be conquered, and he was beaten to death by a group of people in the end. What about even starting to have artillery superiority? Wasn't he still blocked from Paris in the end?
"The most critical thing is logistics! The ammunition consumption of rapid-fire artillery and automatic weapons is too great, you know? During the Franco-Prussian War, we fought for 6 months, but each infantryman only fired an average of 65 rounds of ammunition! This number is even less than the amount of ammunition carried by the soldiers. But now, if I remember correctly, a machine gun The gun can fire more than 450 rounds of bullets in one minute! The logistics pressure of the fully automated troops is too great. It is impossible for us to maneuver quickly without the railway line. If there is no mobility, once the opponent completes their mobilization, our quick victory plan will be in vain, which is absolutely fatal!" the prince said!
With a snap, the spoon in Ruprecht's hand fell into the cup. The prince's words were to the point. He started from the logistical point of view.This proves the reason why the Schlieffen Plan must fail! At this time, Schlieffen had not yet become the Chief of General Staff, and had not yet begun to study his plan that had been planned for more than ten years! This keenness and insight are astonishing. Otherwise, he could become the commander-in-chief of Germany's Eastern Front! This vision and ability are truly amazing!
If the tactical essence of Schlieffen's plan is to concentrate troops on the right wing, and then use an overwhelming force advantage to completely defeat the opponent in a blitzkrieg in a short period of time, then the logistical essence of this plan is to use the railway as an offensive tool, by seizing the opponent's railway line, transporting troops to combat positions in a very short time, and rushing all the way to Paris!
